title: 第17章：新的商机
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
马超快步跑回成衣店，一进门就把手里的野菜递到苏雨琪面前。

    苏雨琪低头一看，愣了一下，有些意外：“这是？野菜？给我的？”

    马超点点头，笑得很实在：“对，上次我就说要给你带礼物。乡下没啥好东西，这些野菜是我亲手挖的，苏姐姐你别嫌弃，要是觉得好吃，我下次再给你带。”

    “不嫌弃、不嫌弃！”苏雨琪连忙摆手，脸上满是笑意，还转头对着苏妈妈晃了晃手里的野菜，一脸雀跃。

    “妈，你快看，这是小超特意给我带的礼物！”

    苏妈妈凑近一看，笑着点点头。

    “这可是好东西，正宗的野生野菜，现在市面上少见得很，有钱都不一定能买到。”

    马超在一旁笑着接话：“阿姨，没花钱，都是我自己去山里挖的，不值钱。”

    “那可不行。”苏妈妈当即摆手，态度很坚决，“这么贵重的东西，不能白拿你的。”

    她看马超穿着朴素，一眼就知道孩子家境普通，心里愈发不好意思占这个便宜，说着就要掏钱给他。
content_en:
Ma Chao quickly ran back to the clothing store and handed the wild vegetables in his hand to Su Yuqi as soon as he entered the door.

    Su Yuqi looked down and was stunned for a moment, a little surprised: "Is this? Wild vegetables? For me?"

    Ma Chao nodded and smiled sincerely: "Yes, I told you last time that I would bring you a gift. There is nothing good in the countryside. I dug these wild vegetables with my own hands. Sister Su, don't dislike them. If you think they are delicious, I will bring them to you next time."

    "I don't dislike it, I don't dislike it!" Su Yuqi waved her hands quickly, with a smile on her face. She also turned to Mother Su and shook the wild vegetables in her hand, with a look of joy on her face.

    "Mom, look, this is a gift Xiaochao specially brought for me!"

    Mother Su took a closer look, smiled and nodded.

    "This is a good thing. Authentic wild vegetables are very rare on the market now. Even if you have money, you may not be able to buy them."

    Ma Chao smiled and answered: "Auntie, I didn't spend any money. I dug it all by myself in the mountains. It's not worth anything."

    "That's not okay." Mother Su waved her hands immediately with a firm attitude, "Such a valuable thing cannot be taken from you for free."

    Seeing Ma Chao's plain clothes, she knew at a glance that the child's family was ordinary, and she felt increasingly embarrassed to take advantage of him, so she decided to pay him.
